channel.title: duk. fresh drops
channel.description: new duk memes, clips, reaction gifs, comics and the duk of the day, as they land. just duk. $DUK

item.title: the market looked everywhere for him. $duk
item.description: Wide shot, night. DUK lies in THE DUK pose in the middle of an empty room. A red candle with eyes creeps in with a flashlight, beam sweeping the walls at head height. "come out." It sweeps right over DUK, every time, and finally leaves: "nobody here." DUK, still flat: "the market looked everywhere."

item.title: pulled the wishbone. wished to stay down. it came true. $duk
item.description: A hand from off-screen holds out a wishbone to DUK and pulls. A bubble: "make a wish." It snaps; the big half flies back at DUK and he drops into THE DUK pose. Bubble: "what did you wish for?" DUK, flat: "to stay down."
